name: Mandelarium
detailed_description:
A shadow stirs in the fractured realm of Mandelarium, where the Old Presence murmurs the Mandorla’s call.

You are Lume, a solitary wanderer from the fog-bound port of the City of Thirme, haunted by visions of bone-white psalms and cosmic dread. Marked by prophecy but unproven, you must endure a brutal cycle of trials to unveil the truth behind the Mandorla — and challenge the understand of an oneiric and ever whispering Old Presence.

Traverse a sprawling metroidvania of ruined cities and alien vistas, where shadows conceal secrets and every path demands precision. Master graceful combat: weave dodges, strikes, and arcane powers to overcome demonic ambushes and the grotesque monarchs of vice.

Unearth forgotten relics, forbidden tomes, and twisted quests that expand the cursed mythos of the world.

To become Mandorlalmond, the herald of The Red, Lume must conquer nightmarish domains, vanquish unholy legions, and expose stories long buried — and fulfil what was planted deep under the ground.

✦ Descend into a Non-Linear Abyss

Drift through the decaying City of Thirme, where fog coils through forgotten alleys and the air hums with the echoes of vanished gods. Beyond lie collapsing sanctuaries, eldritch ruins, and void-choked chasms, shifting under the weight of unseen eyes. Every step deeper into Mandelarium reveals another wound in the world; and in yourself.

✦ Dance of Blade and Dread

Wield your weapons of choice, to cut and smash through the grotesque and the damned. String together attacks, dodges, and reality-fracturing strikes as you channel and awaken the Will of the Mandorla. Unleash cursed techniques to challenge the demonic sovereigns that bar your path to revelation.

✦ Rites of Ruin

Let vengeance become thy ritual. Execute your foes in grim, deliberate displays; each death a symbolic offering. Dismember the malformed in frames of haunting beauty, where every motion is a sermon of violence and transcendence.

✦ Shape Your Curse

Find and fuse Whispered Tomes, Cryptic Relics, and Shards of the Mandorla to rewrite your nature. Will you blur into shadow, or carve a trail of unrelenting force? Shape a playstyle that bends the edge of reality itself.

✦ Dreams Made Into Flesh

Confront nightmares made flesh; towering tyrants born from the Old Presence. Study their warped patterns, survive their cosmic rage, and sever their hold on this world. Each fallen monstrosity yields fragments of forbidden memory, drawing you closer to the Unification.

✦ Echoes in the Deep

The broken world remembers. Lost souls linger — some whisper secrets, others hunger for sacrifice. Seek their truths. Trade mercy for knowledge. The deeper your understanding of Mandelarium, the closer you come to becoming what should thee be: Mandorlalmond.

✦ Immersive Soundscape

Every note is a heartbeat echoing through the fractured corridors of Mandelarium. The immersive soundtrack weaves a delicate tapestry of ghostly echoes, somber chords, and stirring rhythms that elevate every encounter—from the quiet despair of solitary wanderings to the fierce clashes of arcane combat. This atmospheric soundscape is not merely background; it is a living, breathing part of the realm, drawing you ever deeper into its oneiric embrace.

Content Advisory

This game features intense themes that may not be suitable for all players, including:

  • Frequent and stylized depictions of violence

  • Surreal and unsettling imagery inspired by cosmic horror

  • Psychological tension rooted in themes of sacrifice, despair, and identity

short_description: Mandelarium is a haunting metroidvania. As Mandorlalmond, master skills to survive demonic ambushes in decaying cities and eerie landscapes. Uncover treasures, quests, and deep, dark lore as you battle kings of vices. Tread cursed realms, slay demonic hordes, and rip forbidden tales.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) or later
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G4400 / AMD A6-6400K or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R3 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard audio chipset (e.g., Realtek HD Audio)
  • Additional Notes: Display: 800x600 minimum (fullscreen will upscale from 320x180)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel UHD 620 / Vega 8) or any dedicated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard HD Audio (Realtek, VIA, etc.)
  • Additional Notes: Display: 1280x720 or higher
